theorems.name: Submission.dgcr_approxTangent_eq_graph_tangent
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (u : Euclid n → Euclid k) (z : Euclid (n + k)) (s r : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (v₀ : Euclid n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u (ball 0 s) → v₀ ∈ ball (0 : Euclid n) s → 0 < r → μHE[n] ((A ∩ ball (z + ι v₀ + ι' (u v₀)) r) \ ((fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) '' ball (0 : Euclid n) s)) = 0 → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A (z + ι v₀ + ι' (u v₀)) Q → Q = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (fun v => z + ι v + ι' (u v)) v₀ : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k))
